Research Areas of Concentration
Our unique blend of faculty promotes frequent and sometimes unusual opportunities for research collaborations with many disciplines and enables the same problem to be viewed from multiple perspectives.
Training Programs
We are committed to training the next generation of neuroscientists for leading jobs in research, education, and outreach.
People
The Center comprises over 300 faculty, postdocs, students, and staff from 8 affiliated centers, 3 affiliated programs, and 21 affiliated departments.

News & Events
Congratulations to Nathan Schneider, a 2026 Pitt Sustainability Award Winner, Student Category!
Nathan is a PhD candidate in the Center for Neuroscience Program. In their time at Pitt, Nathan has worked tirelessly to incorporate sustainability into the School of Medicine.
Congratulations to Keith Kaufman for 3 wins in the 3MT Competition!
